text: DSH Plugin Crafter 是面向 Web 预设的插件开发辅助包：它把 Plugin Crafter 预设和开发、上游源码查阅及验证 Skills 加入 DSH Agent preset。它根据目标 DSH 版本帮助选择插件扩展点与交付形式，梳理 Host 或 Agent 作用域、配置和可观察结果，并指导检查打包产物、隔离配置及运行行为。配套环境登记工具可记录项目环境和测试案例，供后续会话查找与复用。适合需要开发或维护 DSH 插件并核对行为的开发者；模型路由和凭据由使用者在独立环境中配置。

DSH Plugin Crafter is a Web preset that guides plugin development for a target DSH version. Its bundled Skills help select an extension point, define observable checks, and verify packaged artifacts and runtime behavior. A local registry records test environments and cases for later lookup.
我想按当前 DSH 版本开发一个可安装的插件，先确认该用哪个扩展点。
怎样在独立的 DSH 配置里检查插件打包结果和实际运行行为？
Help me keep plugin development and acceptance checks in separate DSH environments I can find again later.
DSH Plugin Crafter 的功能「插件分层验证」：指导开发者根据目标 DSH 版本检查插件，从打包产物、隔离配置到 Host 实际行为逐层验证。使用验证 Skill 按适用层级操作，并记录版本、观察结果和未覆盖的检查。

dsh-plugin-crafter README · Summary：Develop a DSH plugin while keeping development, acceptance, and daily instances separate. Plugin Crafter guides an agent through version-matched official APIs, implementation, and verification. Its shared environment registry lets later sessions find existing deployments, reuse compatible ones, or record why another environment is needed. Add the bundle to a Web profile and select Plugin Crafter. You manage the actual processes and builds; the registry records them.

dsh-plugin-crafter README · Table of Contents：- [Use this package](#use-this-package) - [Develop with multiple environments](#multi-environment-development) - [Understand the implementation](#understand-the-implementation) - [Further Exploration](#further-exploration) - [Model Experience](#model-experience) - [Known Limitations and Deferred Work](#known-limitations-and-deferred-work) - [Dev Note](#dev-note) -----

dsh-plugin-crafter README · Use this package：Start with a compatible DSH installation, Node `^22.19` or `>=24`, and Python 3.9+ for the registry. The tested DSH target is `0.1.7-alpha.2`; read [compatibility](docs/compatibility.md) before installing into another version.

dsh-plugin-crafter README · Install into an isolated profile：Use an absolute home outside the daily DSH store. Run the commands in the same terminal so installation and launch use the same home:

```sh
export DSH_HOME=/absolute/path/to/crafter-development-home
dsh --profile crafter --from-default-profile web --dump-config
dsh plugin --profile crafter add dsh-plugin-crafter@0.1.0 --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org
dsh --profile crafter --port 3187 --no-open

dsh-plugin-crafter README · Install into an isolated profile：Open the full startup URL privately, create a Session in your plugin repository, and select **Plugin Crafter**. Ask it to develop a plugin, identify the target version, and verify one observable behavior. Provide the matching official source checkout when source inspection is needed. Configure the model route and required credentials in this isolated environment before a model task.

dsh-plugin-crafter README · Install into an isolated profile：The install adds the `plugin-crafter` preset, the official Creator skills, and three Crafter skills. It activates no examples automatically. To remove this layer from the same home, run `dsh plugin --profile crafter remove dsh-plugin-crafter`.

dsh-plugin-crafter README · Develop with multiple environments：An environment records its own home, profile, source checkout, plugin installation, Host identity, and purpose. Each environment can retain multiple case workspaces and Session IDs. The registry persists outside temporary homes, so another conversation can find those records.

dsh-plugin-crafter README · Develop with multiple environments：Reuse a stopped compatible environment for another case. Keep a separate environment when an acceptance Host must remain available, incompatible builds need comparison, or Hosts must run concurrently. Each concurrent Host needs a different home and port. Builds that change served DSH code need a separate checkout; a different profile or port cannot separate shared files.

dsh-plugin-crafter README · Develop with multiple environments：Follow [the multi-environment development guide](docs/isolated-development.md) to query, register, launch, verify, and retain two environments. It explains what is isolated, what remains shared, and how to recover from stale records.

dsh-plugin-crafter README · Choose an example：The [examples](examples/README.md) cover an Agent tool, an authenticated Host route, and a configuration-only preset with a packaged skill. Copy the relevant pattern, then check its API against your chosen DSH version. [Verification evidence](docs/examples-verification.md) distinguishes model-assisted generation, deterministic Host checks, and published-package installation. -----

dsh-plugin-crafter README · Understand the implementation：<details>
<summary>Implementation internals — click to expand</summary>

The [bundle patch](cordis.patch.yml) derives the official Creator composition from the selected source checkout and inserts a distinct `plugin-crafter` preset. The filesystem skill loader resolves this package's skills from the installed package. The [manifest](package.json) declares `dsh.bundle.patch`; the main package has no runtime JavaScript or install scripts.

dsh-plugin-crafter README · Understand the implementation：The [verification skill](skills/dsh-plugin-verification/SKILL.md) selects applicable test layers. Its [registry reference](skills/dsh-plugin-verification/references/environment-registry.md) owns command and storage semantics. The registry records deployments and cases; the smoke runner owns only the Host it launches. Neither record state nor a config dump proves runtime behavior.

dsh-plugin-crafter README · Understand the implementation：The preset derives from the MIT-licensed DeepSeek Harness Creator. The registry adapts the author’s `dsh-plugin-isolated-test` workflow. This is an independent project; see [LICENSE](LICENSE) for attribution. The [contributor guide](docs/development.md) owns local checks and documentation pairing. The selected upstream checkout stays read-only unless a separate DSH change is explicitly in scope. -----

dsh-plugin-crafter README · Model Experience：Indirect. The bundle makes the official Creator skills and the three Crafter skills available to a Session using Plugin Crafter. Those skills guide implementation, source inspection, and verification. The bundle itself emits no tool results; mounted DSH plugins own their model-visible behavior. The [development trial](docs/examples-verification.md) records one guided generation run, not an unattended success guarantee.

dsh-plugin-crafter README · Known Limitations and Deferred Work：The registry does not provision machines, launch Hosts, lease deployments, or check task idleness and build compatibility automatically. Coordinate before two agents mutate one deployment. Separate homes are development isolation, not an operating-system security sandbox. The current runner requires a built matching DSH checkout; Windows Host identity checks are not verified. Model credentials are configured separately. The tested DSH source contains pre-existing LLM and persistence changes; see the [verification scope](docs/examples-verification.md).
